title: Hidden Clues in WM-811K: Uncovering the Spatial Signals Behind Wafer Map Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2611.31292v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: WM-811K (also known as LSWMD) is a wafer map dataset first made publicly available in a 2015 paper by Wu et al. Convolutional neural networks have been used to achieve high classification accuracy on this dataset, yet it's not easy to decipher which features of the dataset are driving that performance. This study attempts to answer this specifically for WM-811K: how much of the predictive performance results from the wafer layout, the count of failed dies, their distance from the center and their exact 2-D location. After analyzing duplicate wafer maps, removing same wafer maps with conflicting labels and ensuring that the same manufacturing lot or exact same map doesn't appear in training, validation and test data, we were left with 25,513 defect-labeled wafer maps from eight classes. We then constructed four variations of each wafer map. The Original was the actual wafer map present in the dataset. The Layout-only kept only the layout

translated_title: WM-811K中的隐藏线索：揭示晶圆图预测背后的空间信号
translated_abstract: WM-811K（也称为LSWMD）是一个晶圆图数据集，最早于2015年由Wu等人在论文中公开发布。卷积神经网络在该数据集上已实现很高的分类准确率，然而很难解读究竟是数据集的哪些特征驱动了这种性能。本研究专门针对WM-811K尝试回答这一问题：预测性能中有多少来自晶圆布局、失效芯片的数量、它们与中心的距离以及它们精确的二维位置。在分析重复晶圆图、删除具有冲突标签的相同晶圆图，并确保同一制造批次或完全相同的晶圆图不会同时出现在训练、验证和测试数据中之后，我们得到了来自八个类别、共25,513张带有缺陷标签的晶圆图。随后我们为每张晶圆图构建了四种变体。原始版本是数据集中实际存在的晶圆图。仅布局版本则只保留了布局……
tldr: 本研究通过为WM-811K晶圆图构建控制变量（布局、失效芯片数量、距中心距离、二维位置）的多种变体，并严格清洗数据集，系统揭示了卷积神经网络预测性能背后真正起作用的空间特征。
en_tdlr: This study systematically reveals which spatial features drive CNN prediction performance on the WM-811K dataset by constructing controlled variations of wafer maps (layout, failed die count, distance from center, and 2-D location) and rigorously cleaning the data.
